title: Optional auxiliary A render-target creation
summary: Recovered aux-target-a at VA 0x4A56C0 (393 bytes) as a genuine thiscall Graphics member and portable dependency adapter. Inspected accepted assembly, direct immutable Game.exe disassembly, both callers (0x4A19CA and 0x4A662E), and helper entry instructions. Any nonzero enable byte +0xA5E creates a one-level D3D9 render-target texture in format 21 using dimensions +0x23C/+0x240 and device +0x78, writing +0x43C; a nonnegative HRESULT then obtains level zero into +0x440. Negative results update the narrow string at +0x54 using original external helpers and return false in AL. Disabled/success returns true. Preserves output writes even on failure, absence of rollback or Release, string ownership transfer, and free-import load order. The original messages say effect target even for this auxiliary target. No matching-source credit claimed.
test_description: Fixed-flag freestanding GCC i386 build and execution passed 248832 direct comparisons against original_aux_target_a. Also checks the original-address C++ member against its adapter in every case. Local link uses local.ld to place accepted original at 0x4A56C0, accepted cookie check at 0x8F8958, C++ string dependency test doubles at 0x416FA0/0x440A20/0x44F380/0x4B2D20, free slot at 0x92D4B0, original prefix text fixtures at 0x9FC5F4/0x9FC740, cookie at 0xBAABC0, and TLS fixture at 0xBAC000. Local run_oracle.py uses ptrace to install a TLS descriptor and FS base before ELF entry, without injecting instructions or modifying oracle code. Sweeps enable 0/1/2/255, independent width/height 0/1/720/4096/0x80000000/0xFFFFFFFF, HRESULT 0/1/INT_MAX/INT_MIN/-1/0x8876086C at both calls, all four write and null masks (excluding null texture on nonnegative creation), old error capacity 15/16, and callback mutation off/on. Asserts exact COM arguments and output addresses, boolean, callback/free order, callback snapshots, complete object bytes including unknown fields and surrounding canaries, retained failure outputs and untouched old error on success. Failure helpers use synthetic descriptions and ownership-transfer fixtures; these are test doubles, not recovered dependencies. Prefix callback can replace free import and create callback can mutate dimensions. Plain default link separately passed all C++ assertions and explicitly reports that original comparison requires fixed mappings/TLS. Linked oracle and cookie fragments compared equal to all 393 and 15 original bytes, respectively; target SHA256 2d96f9e6ce7a4cf17284c381c3824fac2d7252994f4dfd13a655d86470aeee86. Implementation additionally compiles under GCC C++11 O2 with warnings as errors. Optional /tools/msvc/msvc was absent.
known_limits: D3D9 device/texture operations and game string/error formatting/free helpers remain external. Differential tests use C++ spies at their original entry addresses and synthetic descriptions, so they establish the target control flow and ownership interactions, not correctness of those dependencies or real GPU results.

Original Win32 SEH handler 0x902B50, exception unwinding, allocation failure exceptions, and invalid pointer faults are not recovered. Ordinary return paths are modeled; source does not emulate x86 SEH registration or stack-cookie scaffolding.

Full original differential execution requires fixed-address fixtures and an initialized FS descriptor. A plain trusted link without these mappings explicitly runs C++ assertions only. The full local mapped/TLS run passed; local.ld and run_oracle.py document its infrastructure but are not implementation sources.

Temporary destructor heap branches are retained from direct instructions; the ownership-transfer doubles reset consumed temporaries, so those residual heap destructor branches are not dynamically exercised.

The original assumes a valid stored texture after any nonnegative creation result, including when the callback leaves the slot untouched. Tests exclude a null texture followed by its unconditional dereference; no defensive null check is introduced.

Only documented offsets and descriptive field names are recovered, not the complete original class declaration. The fixed layout and original-address entry are for 32-bit pointers; a Linux port must supply actual external services through the adapter and choose its native object layout.

Only AL is the return ABI contract; unspecified upper EAX bits are not modeled. Native MSVC2013 compilation was not available locally; implementation uses C++11 syntax and guarded calling conventions. No matching-byte source claim.
